title: 第17章 强大的力量迅捷的速度第18章 战斗结束
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
在骷髅军士冲刺的路径两侧，突然出现了一阵阵如水面波纹一般的奇异波动。
紧接着，自空间之中，数根完全由灵力构成的灵力锁链。
以迅捷之势奔袭而去。
不出一秒，便将骷髅军士的四肢以及头颅紧紧的束缚住。
突如其来的灵力锁链，也让骷髅军士措手不及。
虽然骷髅军士稍微有一点智慧，但是也仅仅只是比骷髅兵好上那么一点。
但是和人比起来，还是差得太远了。
被束缚住的骷髅军士，由于自己刚才冲刺的惯性原因，瞬间跌倒在地。
而血幽早就已经得到了叶凌的提示，怎么可能轻易放过这个来之不易的机会。
由于使用了狂血的缘故，血幽的力量和速度得到了暴涨。
“咔！”
双腿用力，迸发出全身的力量，坚实的地面，着力的地方出现了裂痕。
突然爆发出来的速度，就连叶凌这个主人，有些惊呆了。
更别说远在一旁观察着战斗的霍仙儿了。
只见血幽整个人化作了一道血色雷霆，刹那间，便出现在被灵力锁链束缚住的骷髅军士身后。
对准骷髅军士的头颅，没有一丝犹豫，狠狠的踢出了一脚。
“轰！
！”
经过加持的力量，如此的恐怖。
一时间烟尘四起，沙石飞溅。

跟在这个骷髅军士身后的其他骷髅，被烟雾遮住了视野。
看不见敌人的踪影，这些骷髅不得不主动停下了自己的脚步。
刚才的一声巨响，叶凌甚至感觉到，自己脚下的骨丘都微微震动了一下。
“还真是一个巨大的惊喜啊。”
叶凌脸上带着满意的笑容。
原本以为狂血的力量提升，不会让血幽的力量提升到多么强大。
但是以现在的情况来看，血幽单纯的破坏力，甚至不弱于霍仙儿手中的地苍龙。
绝对是个意外之喜。
“怎么可能？！
力量竟然会这么强大！”
没错，就算是连霍仙儿本人，此时也是小嘴微张，眼睛瞪得老大。
这和霍仙儿认知之中的僵尸，完全不同，甚至可以说是天差地别。
僵尸虽然力量比较强大，但是再强大也有个限度。
不仅如此，僵尸的速度还非常的慢。
而现在，叶凌手中的僵尸灵宠，所爆发出来的速度宛如雷霆一般。
content_en:
On both sides of the path where the Skeleton Sergeant sprinted, strange fluctuations like ripples on the water suddenly appeared.
Then, from the space, several spiritual power chains composed entirely of spiritual power emerged.
Rush away with swiftness.
Within a second, the skeleton soldier's limbs and head were tightly bound.
The sudden spiritual chain also caught the skeleton sergeant off guard.
Although Skeleton Sergeant is slightly smarter, he is only slightly better than Skeleton Soldier.
But compared with people, it's still far behind.
The restrained skeleton sergeant instantly fell to the ground due to the inertia of his sprint.
And Xueyou had already received Ye Ling's reminder, so how could he easily let go of this hard-won opportunity.
Due to the use of Crazy Blood, Xueyou's strength and speed have skyrocketed.
"Click!"
The legs exerted force, bursting out the strength of the whole body, and cracks appeared on the solid ground where the force was applied.
Even the owner Ye Ling was a little stunned by the sudden burst of speed.
Not to mention Huo Xianer, who was observing the battle from afar.
Xueyou's whole body turned into a bloody thunder, and in an instant, he appeared behind the skeleton sergeant who was bound by spiritual chains.
Aiming at the Skeleton Sergeant's head, he kicked hard without any hesitation.
"Boom!
! "
The power of blessing is so terrifying.
For a time, smoke and dust were everywhere, and sand and rocks were flying.
The other skeletons following the skeleton sergeant were obscured by smoke.
With no trace of the enemy in sight, these skeletons had to take the initiative to stop.
With the loud noise just now, Ye Ling even felt that the bone mounds under his feet shook slightly.
"What a huge surprise."
Ye Ling had a satisfied smile on his face.
I originally thought that the increase in Kuangxue's power would not make Xueyou's power become so powerful.
But judging from the current situation, Xueyou's simple destructive power is not even weaker than the Earth Canglong in Huo Xian'er's hands.
Definitely a surprise.
"How is that possible?!
The power can be so powerful! "
That's right, even Huo Xianer himself had his mouth slightly open and his eyes widened at this time.
This is completely different from the zombies Huo Xianer knows. It can even be said to be worlds apart.
Although zombies are relatively powerful, there is a limit to how powerful they are.
Not only that, the zombies are also very slow.
But now, the zombie pet in Ye Ling's hands bursts out at a speed like thunder.
